<h1 class="hero-name">Isselmou Oumar</h1>

::: {.hero-tagline}
Quantitative Analyst | Paris
:::

::: {.hero-bio}
Quantitative analyst at [Société Générale](https://www.societegenerale.com) working on credit and climate risk: an LLM-based news-analytics pipeline on GDELT now used by credit risk teams, a parallel Monte-Carlo engine for NGFS climate stress testing, and R&D on transition risk in PD models. Previously at [Amundi Technology](https://www.amundi.com), researching carbon-price shock transmission to credit markets through CDS-implied spreads.
:::
